summary_en: This phase 2 trial tests a curcumin supplement (C3 complex/Bioperine) against placebo in people with clonal cytopenia of undetermined significance, low-risk myelodysplastic syndrome, or myeloproliferative neoplasms (polycythemia vera, essential thrombocythemia, or myelofibrosis). Participants take the supplement or placebo by mouth twice a day for 12 months, unless the disease progresses or side effects are unacceptable. The study compares effects on inflammatory cytokines, symptoms and disease parameters; a specific primary outcome is not stated.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 evalúa un suplemento de cúrcuma (complejo C3/Bioperine) comparado con placebo en personas con citopenia clonal de significado indeterminado, síndrome mielodisplásico de bajo riesgo o neoplasias mieloproliferativas (policitemia vera, trombocitemia esencial o mielofibrosis). Los participantes toman el suplemento o el placebo por vía oral dos veces al día durante 12 meses, salvo que la enfermedad progrese o aparezca toxicidad inaceptable. El estudio compara los efectos sobre las citocinas inflamatorias, los síntomas y los parámetros de la enfermedad; no se indica un resultado primario específico.
who_for: Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 2 or less
Polycythemia vera, essential thrombocythemia, or myelofibrosis per WHO 2016 criteria, with at least one symptom scoring above 3
CCUS or low-risk MDS, with persistent cytopenia for more than 6 months
Baseline fatigue symptom score of at least 25
Able to understand and sign written informed consent
not_for: Taking curcumin supplements, including multivitamins, and unwilling to stop 24 hours before study start
Active treatment for another cancer, except hormonal therapy for a cancer in remission or certain growth factors
Taking oral or intravenous steroids or other anti-inflammatory medicines at the listed doses
